reddit.title: Introducing New Features for a More Interactive Colony Experience
reddit.body: We've made some exciting updates to how your colony communicates with you! With thought badges for settlers, a problem-alert stack, and a new compact stats panel, your settlement now reports its needs directly. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back

embed.description: Explore the new features that allow your settlers to express their needs and keep you informed about the state of your colony. Don't miss out!

steam.title: New Interactive Features in Provincia!
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce new features that enhance your interaction with the colony. Settlers will now display thought badges for their needs, and you'll receive alerts for any issues that arise. Dive into the details and see how these changes can improve your gameplay experience! Read more here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back
